 Ask Us About Catering
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Story 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It all began in 1985 in a reclaimed old pizza restaurant on Clairmont Avenue in Birmingham, AL. The formula was simple. Celebrate the heritage of revered bar-b-q masters, cut no corners on the menu, and serve the whole community like family.That philosophy allowed us to create something special. An authentic bar-b-q restaurant with chefs and pitmasters. A nod to our past recipes, with eyes towards the future. Sit down dining on one hand, and a drive-through on the other. No freezers, no microwaves, and no shortcuts. 12-hour slow-smoked pork and beef, but served real fast. A celebration of Alabama, but a reverence for the bar-b-q tradition across the South.It’s the kind of place that only happens when you don’t follow the crowd, but instead follow your heart, trust your gut, and simply do things the hard way. Today, Jim ‘N Nick’s has become an icon of the bar-b-q community. One bite and you’ll understand why, there’s only one Jim ‘N Nick’s.

 PARTIES | WEDDINGS | TAILGATES | CORPORATE EVENTS 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 BRINGING THE BAR-B-Q 
 
 
 
 STRAIGHT TO YOU 
 
 
 
 We’ve been catering events for almost 40 years and bringing our best to every single one. No matter what you’re planning, we’ve got the Bar-B-Q for you, with a friendly team focused on making your event flawless and fun. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FULL-SERVICE 
 
 
 
 Our slow-smoked Bar-B-Q and homemade sides served by our friendly catering staff. We’ll set up and maintain your buffet, plus any stations you may add.
Full-Service Bar-B-Q buffets and action stations
Dedicated catering staff 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 GET A QUOTE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DELIVERY & SET-UP 
 
 
 
 The same great Bar-B-Q, minus the catering staff. We’ll deliver and set up your buffet or box meals, then head out and let you take the reins.Quick and easy buffet setupsFlexible option for DIY service 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ORDER NOW
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 PICKUP ONLY 
 
 
 
 Prefer to set things up yourself? Our catering packages have you covered with your favorite meats, sides, buns, Bar-B-Q sauce, and disposable plates and utensils.Self-service pickup in restaurant 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ORDER NOW
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 WE'RE ALL IN 
 
 
 
 CATERING FOR ANY EVENT 
 
 
 
 Business or pleasure, formal or low-key, if you’ve got an event, we’ve got the Bar-B-Q for you. Our catering specialists can set you up with box lunches for convenient company meetings, spreads for outdoor events of all sizes, or a customized menu for a full-service Bar-B-Q buffet.Looking for something a bit more interactive? We’ve got you covered with our Bar-B-Q action stations: smoked meat carving, build your own loaded Bar-B-Q baker or mac & cheese, and of course the ultimate Bar-B-Q event, the whole hog experience. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOWNLOAD CATERING MENU
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 YES, OF COURSE 
 
 
 
 WE DO WEDDINGS 
 
 
 
 We’re honored to celebrate love in our communities. Let us play a small role in your big day by serving your friends and family our hickory smoked Bar-B-Q. We’ll bring our full-service expertise and enthusiasm, including the same delicious Bar-B-Q buffets and interactive stations. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CATER MY WEDDING
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CATERING REVIEWS

We had over ordered by a bit but it was no problem getting our guests to take home a to-go box. The staff worked seamlessly with us on the details such as how many sides we wanted and table ware options (we wanted to use our own). This is a wonderful restaurant for dine in or catering.
